documents.title: About CGC Landran Campus and Accreditation
documents.summary: Overview of CGC Landran, establishment, NAAC A+ accreditation, and affiliation with IKGPTU.
documents.content: Chandigarh Group of Colleges (CGC) Landran, established in 2001, is located in Sector 112, Landran, Greater Mohali, Punjab (near Chandigarh). CGC Landran is accredited with NAAC A+ Grade and several engineering and pharmacy programs are NBA accredited. It is affiliated with I.K. Gujral Punjab Technical University (IKGPTU), Jalandhar for technical, management, pharmacy, and computer applications programs, and approved by AICTE and PCI. The campus spans over 45 acres with state-of-the-art academic blocks, research labs, centralized library, incubation centers, and residential hostels.

documents.title: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Program & Semester Structure
documents.summary: Detailed semester-by-semester subjects for the 3-Year BCA program under IKGPTU affiliation at CGC Landran.
documents.content:
Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) 3-Year Degree (6 Semesters) under IKGPTU:
- Semester 1: Programming in C (UGCA1901), Fundamentals of Computer & IT (UGCA1902), Mathematics (UGCA1903), Communication Skills (BTHU103), Programming in C Lab (UGCA1904), IT Lab (UGCA1905).
- Semester 2: Object Oriented Programming using C++ (UGCA1906), Data Structures (UGCA1907), Digital Circuits & Logic Design (UGCA1908), Environmental Science (EVS102), C++ Lab (UGCA1909), Data Structures Lab (UGCA1910).
- Semester 3: Database Management Systems (UGCA1911), Computer Networks (UGCA1912), Operating Systems (UGCA1913), DBMS Lab (UGCA1914), Computer Networks Lab (UGCA1915), Soft Skills Lab.
- Semester 4: Java Programming (UGCA1916), Web Technologies (HTML/CSS/JS) (UGCA1917), Software Engineering (UGCA1918), Discrete Mathematics, Java Lab (UGCA1919), Web Technologies Lab (UGCA1920).
- Semester 5: Programming in PHP / Python (UGCA1921), Cloud Computing (UGCA1922), Information Security / Cyber Laws (UGCA1923), Open Elective I, Server-Side Web Programming Lab (UGCA1924), Minor Project-I.
- Semester 6: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning basics (UGCA1925), Mobile Application Development (Android/React Native) (UGCA1926), Major Project / Industrial Training (UGCA1927), Seminar.
Official PTU syllabus documents can be accessed at https://ptu.ac.in/syllabus and https://ptu.ac.in/.

documents.title: BCA Semester 5 Detailed Course Outline & PHP/Web Track
documents.summary: Unit-wise syllabus for BCA 5th semester covering Server Side Scripting with PHP, Cloud Fundamentals, and Project Guidelines.
documents.content:
BCA Semester 5 Detailed Syllabus Overview:
1. Server-Side Web Technologies (PHP & MySQL):
   - Unit I: Introduction to PHP, syntax, variables, data types, operators, flow control, functions, arrays, and string handling.
   - Unit II: Form handling (, ), state management (sessions, cookies), file uploads, and sanitization.
   - Unit III: MySQL database integration using PDO/MySQLi: connect, query execution, prepared statements, CRUD operations.
   - Unit IV: Object Oriented PHP (Classes, Inheritance, Interfaces), JSON handling, and RESTful API fundamentals.
2. Cloud Computing Fundamentals:
   - Cloud models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS), virtualization, AWS/Azure fundamentals, security, and storage services.
3. Information Security & Cyber Laws:
   - Cryptography basics, symmetric/asymmetric encryption, firewall principles, IT Act 2000, and OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities.
4. Minor Project-I: Development of full-stack database-backed web application under faculty mentorship.

documents.title: B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering (CSE) - Core Subjects & Tracks
documents.summary: Curriculum overview for 4-Year B.Tech CSE program including core engineering, labs, and specializations.
documents.content:
B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering (4 Years / 8 Semesters) affiliated with IKGPTU at Chandigarh Engineering College (CEC), Landran:
- First Year: Engineering Mathematics, Physics/Chemistry, Programming for Problem Solving (Python/C), Basic Electrical Engineering, Engineering Graphics & Design.
- Core CSE (Sem 3 to 6): Data Structures & Algorithms, Object Oriented Programming (Java/C++), Computer Organization & Architecture, Discrete Mathematics, Operating Systems, Database Management Systems, Formal Language & Automata Theory (FLAT), Design & Analysis of Algorithms (DAA), Computer Networks, Compiler Design, Software Engineering.
- Specialization Electives (Sem 6 to 8): Artificial Intelligence & ML, Data Science, Cyber Security, Internet of Things (IoT), Cloud Computing, and Blockchain.
- Practical & Industry: 6-month Industrial Training in 7th/8th Semester, Major Capstone Project, Design Thinking & Innovation Labs.

documents.title: Central Library Facilities, Resources & Book Bank
documents.summary: CGC Central Library holdings, circulation rules, timings, reading halls, and Book Bank scheme for students.
documents.content:
CGC Landran Central Library (Knowledge Resource Centre):
- Collection: Over 40,000+ printed volumes, 3,500+ titles covering Engineering, Computer Applications, Management, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, and General Sciences.
- Timings: Monday to Saturday from 8:30 AM to 8:00 PM. Reading hall open up to 10:00 PM during mid-semester and end-semester examinations.
- Book Bank Facility: Subsidized book bank scheme providing a complete set of prescribed textbooks for the entire semester to registered students.
- Circulation Privileges: Undergraduate students can borrow up to 3 books for 14 days; Postgraduate students up to 5 books for 21 days; Faculty members up to 8 books for a semester.
- Reading Hall Capacity: Air-conditioned reading halls accommodating over 500 students simultaneously with high-speed Wi-Fi access.

documents.title: Digital Library, E-Journals, DELNET & NDLI Subscriptions
documents.summary: Access to online repositories including DELNET, National Digital Library of India (NDLI), IEEE Xplore, and OPAC.
documents.content:
CGC Landran Digital Library & Online Databases:
- Online Public Access Catalogue (OPAC): Fully automated with Koha/ERP software allowing students to search book availability, author, title, and shelf location from any campus terminal or mobile portal.
- Subscribed Databases: IEEE Xplore Digital Library, ScienceDirect/Elsevier, SpringerLink, J-Gate, and EBSCOhost for engineering, management, and pharmacy research papers.
- National Resource Networks: Institutional Member of DELNET (Developing Library Network) enabling Inter-Library Loan (ILL) and document delivery across 5,000+ partner libraries.
- National Digital Library of India (NDLI): Registered NDLI Institutional Club member providing free access to 60+ million digital learning resources, video lectures, and rare manuscripts.
- E-Newspapers & Magazines: Economic Times, The Hindu, Indian Express, Business Standard, PCQuest, and Harvard Business Review accessible in the digital reading section.

documents.title: Library Code of Conduct, Membership Rules & Overdue Policies
documents.summary: Rules regarding student ID cards, barcode scanning, overdue fines (Rs. 2/day), lost book replacement, and silence zones.
documents.content:
Library Regulations & Student Guidelines:
- Identity Card: Student ID card with barcode is strictly non-transferable and mandatory for entering the library and borrowing books.
- Overdue Policy: Books must be returned or renewed on or before the due date. An overdue fine of Rs. 2 per day per book is levied after the due date.
- Lost / Damaged Books: The borrower must replace the book with the latest edition or pay twice the current market cost of the book plus accumulated fines.
- Reference & Rare Books: Encyclopedias, dictionaries, project reports, and current periodical issues are for reference use only and cannot be issued outside the library premises.
- Conduct: Cell phones must be kept in silent/vibration mode. Discussion is restricted to designated collaborative discussion rooms.

documents.title: Admission Procedure, Eligibility Criteria & Verification Rules
documents.summary: Eligibility norms, registration workflow, documents required, and official contact channels for admissions.
documents.content:
Admission Guidelines at CGC Landran:
- Application Process: Online registration via official portal https://www.cgc.edu.in or offline visit to Admission Block, CGC Landran.
- Eligibility Criteria:
  * B.Tech: Passed 10+2 with Physics, Mathematics, and one optional subject with minimum 45% marks (40% for reserved categories) and valid JEE Main score or State merit counselling.
  * BCA: 10+2 in any stream with minimum 50% marks (45% for reserved category) with Mathematics/Computer Science/IT preferred.
  * BBA / B.Com: 10+2 in any recognized stream with at least 50% aggregate marks.
  * B.Pharm: 10+2 with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology/Mathematics with minimum 50% marks.
  * MBA / MCA: Bachelor’s degree of minimum 3-year duration with at least 50% marks from a recognized university.
- Documents Required: 10th & 12th Marksheets, Graduation degree (for PG), Migration Certificate, Character Certificate, Caste Certificate (if applicable), Aadhaar Card, Passport photographs.
- Note: Tuition fees, scholarships (e.g. Josh Scholarship, Post-Matric schemes), and seat quotas are subject to PTU & State Government counselling notifications. For fee details, students must consult official admissions counsellors at 1800 200 3575.

documents.title: PTU Examination Rules, Internal Assessments & Grading System
documents.summary: Information regarding MSTs, End Semester exams, minimum 75% attendance rule, SGPA/CGPA grading, and re-evaluation.
documents.content:
Examination and Assessment Policies:
- Minimum Attendance: Mandatory 75% attendance in theory and laboratory classes to be eligible to appear in End Semester Examinations as per IKGPTU ordinances.
- Mid-Semester Tests (MSTs): Two centralized MSTs conducted each semester contributing to the continuous internal assessment marks along with assignments and attendance.
- End Semester Examination: Conducted centrally by IKGPTU at designated university exam centers.
- Grading Scale: 10-point letter grading system (O: Outstanding, A+: Excellent, A: Very Good, B+: Good, B: Above Average, C: Pass, F: Fail).
- Re-appear / Re-evaluation: Students can register for re-appear exams in subsequent semesters or apply for answer script re-checking through the PTU student portal (https://ptu.ac.in).

documents.title: Academic Departments and Colleges at CGC Landran
documents.summary: Complete roster of academic departments, constituent colleges, and faculties operating at CGC Landran.
documents.content:
CGC Landran comprises 7 major constituent colleges and 10+ specialized academic departments offering AICTE, PCI, and IKGPTU approved programs:

1. **Department of Computer Applications (DCA)**
   - Constituent Institute: Chandigarh Business School of Administration / DCA
   - Key Programs: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA - 3 Years), Master of Computer Applications (MCA - 2 Years)
   - Focus: Web Development (PHP/Python/Full-Stack), Cloud Computing, App Development, Database Systems, Software Engineering.

2. **Department of Computer Science & Engineering (CSE)**
   - Constituent Institute: Chandigarh Engineering College (CEC - NAAC A+, NBA Accredited)
   - Key Programs: B.Tech CSE, B.Tech AI & Data Science, B.Tech AI & Machine Learning, M.Tech CSE, B.Tech Lateral Entry.
   - Focus: Algorithms, Machine Learning, Cloud Architecture, Cyber Security, High-Performance Computing.

3. **Department of Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE)**
   - Constituent Institute: Chandigarh Engineering College (CEC)
   - Key Programs: B.Tech ECE, M.Tech ECE, B.Tech Lateral Entry.
   - Focus: VLSI Design, Embedded Systems, IoT, Wireless Communication, Signal Processing.

4. **Department of Mechanical Engineering (ME) & Civil Engineering (CE)**
   - Constituent Institute: Chandigarh Engineering College (CEC)
   - Key Programs: B.Tech Mechanical Engineering, B.Tech Civil Engineering.
   - Focus: CAD/CAM Robotics, Thermal Engineering, Structural Design, Surveying, Environmental Tech.

5. **Department of Management Studies**
   - Constituent Institute: Chandigarh Business School of Administration (CBSA)
   - Key Programs: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA - 3 Years), Master of Business Administration (MBA - 2 Years Dual Specialization).
   - Focus: Marketing, Finance, HR, Business Analytics, International Business, Corporate Entrepreneurship.

6. **Department of Commerce**
   - Constituent Institute: Chandigarh Business School of Administration (CBSA)
   - Key Programs: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com Hons. - 3 Years).
   - Focus: Auditing, Financial Accounting, Corporate Taxation, Fintech, GST & Corporate Law.

7. **Department of Pharmaceutical Sciences**
   - Constituent Institute: Chandigarh College of Pharmacy (CCP - PCI & AICTE Approved)
   - Key Programs: B.Pharm (4 Years), B.Pharm Lateral Entry (3 Years), M.Pharm (Pharmaceutics, Pharmacology).
   - Focus: Drug Formulation, Pharmacology, Medicinal Chemistry, Clinical Trials, Pharmacovigilance.

8. **Department of Biotechnology & Applied Sciences**
   - Constituent Institute: Chandigarh Group of Colleges (CGC)
   - Key Programs: B.Sc (Hons.) Biotechnology, B.Sc (Hons.) Microbiology, M.Sc Biotechnology.
   - Focus: Recombinant DNA, Microbial Genetics, Bio-process Engineering, Immunology, Plant/Animal Tissue Culture.

9. **Department of Hotel Management & Catering Technology**
   - Constituent Institute: Chandigarh College of Hospitality (CCH)
   - Key Programs: B.Sc Hospitality & Hotel Administration, Bachelor of Hotel Management & Catering Technology (BHMCT - 4 Years).
   - Focus: Culinary Arts, Food & Beverage Service, Front Office Operations, Tourism & Resort Management.

10. **Department of Applied Sciences & Humanities**
    - Constituent Institute: Chandigarh Engineering College (CEC)
    - Focus: Engineering Physics, Engineering Chemistry, Engineering Mathematics, Communication Skills, and Professional Ethics for First-Year Engineering.
